description: Search the full text of books scanned by the Internet Archive — the "which book contains this passage?" lookup that the metadata tools cannot answer. Quote a phrase for an exact-phrase match; bare terms match anywhere in the text. Each result is an Internet Archive item with the matching passages as snippets, plus a relevance score. The full-text index is far slower than the metadata endpoints, and a search usually takes 10–30 seconds. Use it when the passage is the question, and use openlibrary_search_books to search by title, author, or subject. Results key on Internet Archive items rather than Open Library works: chain the returned ia_identifier to archive.org, or match it against the ia_identifiers on openlibrary_search_books results to reach the catalogue record.

limit.description: Max matching items to return. Each carries its own snippets, so higher values grow the response quickly — prefer 10–20.

query.description: Text to find inside scanned books. Wrap in double quotes for an exact-phrase match (e.g., "the spice must flow"); unquoted terms match independently and return far broader results.

name: openlibrary_search_inside

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_unavailable`: Open Library's full-text search answered HTTP 200 without a result set — no hits object carrying a total. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

matches.description: Matching items, up to limit, ordered by relevance.

items.description: A book whose scanned text contains the query.

creator.description: Author or creator from Internet Archive metadata, as catalogued (e.g., "Burridge, Jay, author"). Absent when not recorded — genuinely missing on some items, not an error.

ia_identifier.description: Internet Archive item identifier — readable at https://archive.org/details/{ia_identifier}, and the same value openlibrary_search_books returns in ia_identifiers.

score.description: Relevance score from the full-text index. Comparable within one result set only.

snippets.description: Passages containing the match, with the upstream highlight markers removed. The text output caps how many are rendered per item; this array is complete.

title.description: Item title from Internet Archive metadata. Absent when not recorded.

notice.description: Guidance when the page is empty (how to broaden a query that matched nothing, or which offset to retry when offset ran past the end) or when the text output capped a per-item snippet list. Absent when neither applies.

offset.description: Zero-based offset of the first returned match.

total.description: Total matching Internet Archive items across all pages.

totalCount.description: Total matching items across all pages — the upstream match count, reported even when this page is empty because offset ran past the end.

title: Search Inside Books
